highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 aligns HarfBuzz bindings with the bundled engine and improves GPU failure handling.
highlights_body: The Skia m154 release also packages source-authored API XML beside managed assemblies. Review the HarfBuzz enum migrations and the removal of RAW/DNG decoding before upgrading.

breaking.title: Rename UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 to CCC132
breaking.body: HarfBuzzSharp follows the corrected upstream enum name without retaining an alias. Replace UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 with UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132; its numeric value remains 132.

breaking.title: Replace GlyphFlags.Defined with concrete flags
breaking.body: HarfBuzzSharp no longer exposes GlyphFlags.Defined, an aggregate mask rather than an independent option. Combine the concrete glyph flags your code requires. The corresponding BufferFlags.Defined and SerializeFlag.Defined aggregate masks are not exposed either.

breaking.title: Use an external decoder for RAW and DNG images
breaking.body: Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode these files externally before passing pixels to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng remains for compatibility, but does not indicate codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to m154, including upstream SVG color-filter improvements and Ganesh clipping fixes. The milestone sync preserves existing C exports; native HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1 despite its .400 package revision.

bullets.lead: Supported HarfBuzz enum values track the native source
bullets.detail: Synchronizes supported buffer, cluster, glyph, and baseline-tag enum values with HarfBuzz 14.2.1. No new managed types or callback-heavy API families are introduced.

bullets.lead: API documentation travels with reference assemblies
bullets.detail: Packages include matching compiler-generated XML beside implementation and reference assemblies, so source-authored API documentation reaches package consumers without changing which obsolete members are compile-visible.

bullets.lead: GPU atlas tracking and failure propagation
bullets.detail: Corrects partial glyph-atlas generation tracking and propagates Ganesh prerequisite failures instead of continuing image creation or handle extraction. Unsupported asynchronous reads complete with a null result; existing managed flush signatures stay void.

bullets.lead: Failed GPU uploads no longer feed stale draws
bullets.detail: Ganesh checks failed buffer uploads and initialization under memory pressure instead of drawing stale contents. Triangulated paths retain CPU vertex data for a later upload attempt.

bullets.lead: Failed flushes discard unusable cached textures
bullets.detail: Ganesh drops uniquely held thread-safe cache entries after a failed flush, preventing later draws from reusing entries for textures that were never initialized. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed.

bullets.lead: Uno WebAssembly uses matching HarfBuzz assets
bullets.detail: The Uno views package depends on the matching HarfBuzzSharp WebAssembly native-assets package, avoiding missing-symbol links against an older implicit archive.

Corrects the compiler-warning configuration that caused BinSkim BA2007 failures in applications consuming HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32. Native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Corrected Windows HarfBuzz compiler-warning configuration so consuming applications pass BinSkim BA2007

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the line with Skia m154. HarfBuzzSharp moved to the .400 package revision bucket while its native engine remained 14.2.1.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11: Preview 2 synchronized supported HarfBuzz enum values, including the CCC132 rename and removal of GlyphFlags.Defined, and packaged API XML beside reference assemblies. It also corrected GPU atlas, flush, and upload handling.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14: Release Candidate 1 retired built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW JPEG-preview extraction; no replacement decoder is included.

harfbuzz_summary: Bindings now follow the bundled HarfBuzz 14.2.1 source, including supported enum additions, the CCC132 rename, and removal of GlyphFlags.Defined. Packages carry source-authored API XML, and Windows native assets correct BinSkim BA2007 failures; no native engine upgrade is implied by revision .400.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: Preview 1 opened the Skia m154 line while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11.headline: Preview 2 added packaged compiler XML, synchronized HarfBuzz enums, and corrected glyph-atlas, GPU-upload, Windows BinSkim, and Uno WebAssembly issues.

v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14.headline: The release candidate removed built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction.

v4.154.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 clears uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes.
